versions.changelog:
Initial release — introduces skill for simple, math-based forecasting, gap analysis, what-if simulation, and depletion/saturation prediction based on existing data.

- Supports four scenarios: trend extrapolation, target gap analysis, what-if simulation, and depletion/saturation prediction.
- Automatically triggers when user intentions relate to "future" or "what-if," even if not explicitly stated.
- Delegates all data queries to the metric-query skill; this skill only handles forecasting logic on returned data.
- Includes standard Python code for local linear regression, moving average, and related calculations.
- Emphasizes necessary caveats: all forecasts depend on recent trends and are not machine learning predictions. Results include uncertainty and assumption notes.
- Provides clear guidelines distinguishing from metric-query, anomaly-detection, and metric-attribution skills.
